checks.text: The page shows the heading "Mastermind Game", a field labelled "Seed", a button labelled "New game", a button labelled "Undo", a button labelled "Redo", a button labelled "Copy result", and the text "Best score: 0".
With the field labelled "Seed" set to "1" and clicking "New game", the board shows four empty rows, each with four empty peg slots, and the text "Guesses: 0".
With seed 1, in row 1, selecting "Red" in the four peg selectors and clicking "Submit guess" shows the feedback "1 exact, 0 partial" and updates "Guesses: 1".

In row 2, selecting "Red" in the first peg, "Blue" in the second, "Green" in the third, and "Yellow" in the fourth, then clicking "Submit guess" shows the feedback "4 exact, 0 partial" and the text "You win in 2 guesses".
Clicking "Copy result" after winning shows the toast "Result copied" and the clipboard contains "Seed 1: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow - 2 guesses".
With the field labelled "Seed" set to "2" and clicking "New game", the board resets to four empty rows and "Guesses: 0"; the text "Best score: 2" is visible.
With seed 1, in row 1, selecting "Blue", "Red", "Yellow", "Green" in the four pegs in that order and clicking "Submit guess" shows the feedback "0 exact, 4 partial" and "Guesses: 1".
Clicking "Undo" after one guess clears row 1's pegs and feedback, and shows "Guesses: 0"; clicking "Redo" restores the guess and shows "Guesses: 1".
Reload keeps the best score: after winning with Seed 1 in 2 guesses, reloading the page still shows "Best score: 2".
